meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络模型，模拟基因敲除与通量分布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做代谢网络建模或代谢工程分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network models, simulate gene knockouts and flux distributions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on constraint-based metabolic modeling or metabolic engineering analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以加载、编辑和运行代谢模型，执行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量可变性分析（FVA）、基因敲除筛选、通量采样等计算，并输出生长速率、代谢物通量等结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析代谢模型、预测细胞生长、设计培养基或进行基因敲除模拟时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型并计算生长速率。
say.note: Claude 会运行 FBA 并输出生长速率。

say.text: 对模型 iJO1366 进行单基因敲除筛选。
say.note: Claude 会执行单基因敲除分析并列出必需基因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load, edit, and run metabolic models, perform FBA, FVA, gene knockout screens, flux sampling, and output growth rates and metabolite fluxes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze metabolic models, predict growth, design media, or simulate gene knockouts.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and compute the growth rate.
say_en.note: Claude will run FBA and output the growth rate.

say_en.text: Perform single gene deletion screen on model iJO1366.
say_en.note: Claude will run single_gene_deletion and list essential genes.
Claude will call minimal_medium and output exchange reactions.
